full_text_zh:
[P1] 爷爷一定有办法
文·图 菲比·吉尔曼 译 宋珮
少年儿童出版社
优秀读物

[P2] 当约瑟还是娃娃的时候，
爷爷为他缝了一条奇妙的毯子……

[P3] ……毯子又舒服、又保暖，还可以把噩梦通通赶跑。不过，约瑟渐渐长大了，奇妙的毯子也变得老旧了。

[P4] 有一天，妈妈对他说：
“约瑟，看看你的毯子，又破又旧，
好难看，真该把它丢了。”

[P5] 约瑟说：“爷爷一定有办法。”
爷爷拿起了毯子，翻过来，又翻过去。

[P6] “嗯……”爷爷拿起剪刀开始咯吱、咯吱地剪，
再用针飞快地缝进、缝出、缝进、缝出。
爷爷说：“这块料子还够做……”

[P7] ……一件奇妙的外套。
约瑟穿上这件奇妙的外套，开心地跑出去玩了。
不过，约瑟渐渐长大，奇妙的外套也变得老旧了。

[P8] 有一天，妈妈对他说：
“约瑟，看看你的外套，缩水了、变小了，
一点儿也不合身，真该把它丢了！”，

[P9] 约瑟说：“爷爷一定有办法。”
爷爷拿起了外套，翻过来，又翻过去。

[P10] “嗯……”爷爷拿起剪刀开始咯吱、咯吱地剪，
再用针飞快地缝进、缝出、缝进、缝出。
爷爷说：“这块料子还够做……”

[P11] ……一件奇妙的背心。
第二天，约瑟穿着这件奇妙的背心去上学。
不过，约瑟渐渐长大了，奇妙的背心也变得
老旧了。

[P12] 有一天，妈妈对他说：“约瑟，看看你的背心！
上面沾了胶，又粘着颜料，真该把它丢了！”，

[P13] 约瑟说：“爷爷一定有办法。”
爷爷拿起了背心，翻过来，又翻过去。

[P14] “嗯……”爷爷拿起剪刀开始咯吱、咯吱地剪，
再用针飞快地缝进、缝出、缝进、缝出。
爷爷说：“这块料子还够做……”

[P15] ……一条奇妙的领带。
每个礼拜五，约瑟都戴着这条奇妙的领带
去爷爷奶奶家。不过，约瑟渐渐长大了，
奇妙的领带也变得老旧了。

[P16] 有一天，妈妈对他说：
“约瑟，看看你的领带！沾到汤，脏了一大块，
弄得它都变形了，真该把它丢了！”，

[P17] 约瑟说：“爷爷一定有办法。”
爷爷拿起了领带，翻过来，又翻过去。

[P18] “嗯……”爷爷拿起剪刀开始喀吱、喀吱地剪，
再用针飞快地缝进、缝出、缝进、缝出。
爷爷说：“这块料子还够做……”

[P19] ……一块奇妙的手帕。
约瑟收集的小石头，就用这块奇妙的手帕
包得好好的。不过，约瑟渐渐长大了，
奇妙的手帕也变得老旧了。

[P20] 有一天，妈妈对他说：
“约瑟，看看你的手帕！已经用得破破烂烂、
斑斑点点的，真该把它丢了！”

[P21] 约瑟说：“爷爷一定有办法。”
爷爷拿起了手帕，翻过来，又翻过去。

[P22] “嗯……”爷爷拿起剪刀开始咯吱、咯吱地剪，
再用针飞快地缝进、缝出、缝进、缝出。
爷爷说：“这块料子还够做……”

[P23] ……一颗奇妙的纽扣。
约瑟把这颗奇妙的纽扣装在他的吊带上，
这样裤子就不会滑下来了。

[P24] 有一天，妈妈对他说：“约瑟，你的纽扣呢？”
约瑟一看，纽扣不见了！

[P25] 他找遍了所有的地方，就是找不到纽扣。
约瑟跑到爷爷家。

[P26] 约瑟嚷着：“我的纽扣！我的奇妙纽扣不见了！”
他的妈妈跟着跑来，说：“约瑟！听我说。”

[P27] “那颗纽扣没有了、不在了、消失了。
即使是爷爷也没办法无中生有呀！
爷爷难过地摇摇头，说：
“约瑟啊，你妈妈说得没错。”

[P28] 第二天，约瑟去上学。
“嗯……”约瑟拿起笔来，
在纸上刷刷刷地写着，
他说：“这些材料还够……”

[P29] ……写成一个奇妙的故事。
full_text_en:
[P1] Grandfather Has a Plan
Text and Illustrations by Phoebe Gilman, Translated by Song Pei
Children's Publishing House
Excellent Reading Material

[P2] When Joseph was still a baby,
Grandfather sewed him a wonderful blanket...

[P3] ……The blanket was comfortable and warm, and could chase away all the bad dreams. However, Joseph grew bigger and bigger, and the wonderful blanket also became old and worn out.

[P4] One day, his mother said to him:
"Joseph, look at your blanket. It's torn and old,
ugly, we really should throw it away."

[P5] Joseph said, "Grandfather always has a way."
Grandfather picked up the blanket, turned it over, and turned it over again.

[P6] "Hmm..." Grandfather picked up the scissors and began to snip, snip, then quickly stitched in, out, in, out with the needle.
Grandfather said: "This piece of fabric is still enough to make..."

[P7] ……A wonderful coat.
Joseph put on this wonderful coat and happily ran out to play.
However, as Joseph grew bigger, the wonderful coat also became old and worn.

[P8] One day, Mom said to him:
"Joseph, look at your coat. It's shrunk and gotten too small.
It doesn't fit at all. We really should throw it away!"

[P9] Joseph said, "Grandfather always has a way."
Grandfather picked up the coat, turned it over, and flipped it again.

[P10] "Hmm..." Grandfather picked up the scissors and began to snip, snip, snip,
then quickly stitched in, out, in, out with the needle.
Grandfather said: "This piece of fabric is still enough to make..."

[P11] ……A wonderful vest.
The next day, Joseph wore this wonderful vest to school.
However, Joseph gradually grew up, and the wonderful vest also became
old and worn out.

[P12] One day, Mom said to him, "Joseph, look at your vest!
It's covered in glue and paint, you really should throw it away!"

[P13] Joseph said, "Grandfather always has a way."
Grandfather picked up the vest, turned it over, and then turned it over again.

[P14] "Hmm..." Grandfather picked up the scissors and began to snip, snip, snip,
then quickly stitched in, out, in, out with the needle.
Grandfather said: "This piece of fabric is still enough to make..."

[P15] ……A wonderful tie.
Every Friday, Joseph wears this wonderful tie
to his grandparents' house. But Joseph is growing up,
and the wonderful tie is getting old.

[P16] One day, Mom said to him:
"Joseph, look at your tie! It's stained with soup, dirty in a big patch,
and it's all warped. We really should throw it away!"

[P17] Joseph said, "Grandfather always has a way."
Grandfather picked up the tie, turned it over, and turned it over again.

[P18] "Hmm..." Grandfather picked up the scissors and began snipping, snipping,
then quickly stitching in, out, in, out with the needle.
Grandfather said, "This piece of fabric is still enough to make..."

[P19] ……a wonderful handkerchief.
Joseph's collected little stones were wrapped up neatly in this wonderful handkerchief. But as Joseph grew bigger,
the wonderful handkerchief also became old and worn.

[P20] One day, Mom said to him:
"Joseph, look at your handkerchief! It's all worn out and stained. It's really time to throw it away!"

[P21] Joseph said, "Grandfather always has a way."
Grandfather picked up the handkerchief, turned it over, and then turned it over again.

[P22] "Hmm..." Grandfather picked up the scissors and began to snip, snip, snip,
then quickly stitched in, out, in, out with the needle.
Grandfather said: "This piece of fabric is still enough to make..."

[P23] ……A wonderful button.
Joseph fastened this wonderful button onto his suspenders,
so his pants wouldn't slip down.

[P24] One day, Mom said to him, "Joseph, where is your button?"
Joseph looked, and the button was gone!

[P25] He looked everywhere, but couldn't find the button.
Joseph ran to his grandfather's house.

[P26] Joseph shouted, “My button! My wonderful button is gone!”
His mother ran after him and said, “Joseph! Listen to me.”

[P27] "That button is gone, not here, disappeared.
Even Grandfather can't create something from nothing!
Grandfather sadly shakes his head and says:
'Joseph, your mother is right.'"

[P28] The next day, Joseph went to school.
"Hmm..." Joseph picked up his pen,
and wrote quickly on the paper,
saying, "These materials are still enough..."

[P29] ……Write a wonderful story.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《爷爷一定有办法》的封面，展示了爷爷牵着孙子的手走在乡间小路上的温馨画面，背景是蓝天、房屋和飞翔的小鸟，传递出温暖与亲情的主题。
[P2] 画面中爷爷正在缝制一条蓝色的毯子，下方文字说明这是他为还是娃娃的约瑟缝制的奇妙毯子，开启了故事的开端。
[P3] 画面展示约瑟婴儿时期躺在摇篮里，全家围在身边，下方文字说明毯子虽舒适保暖，但随着约瑟长大，毯子也逐渐变旧。
[P4] 妈妈看着约瑟的旧毯子，觉得又破又旧，建议把它扔掉。
[P5] 约瑟对爷爷说‘爷爷一定有办法’，爷爷拿起旧毯子仔细翻看，思考如何处理。
[P6] 爷爷拿起剪刀和针线，开始认真地裁剪和缝制旧毯子，思考如何将它改造成新的物品。
[P7] 约瑟穿上爷爷改造成的奇妙外套，开心地跑出去玩耍，但随着他长大，外套也逐渐变得老旧。
[P8] 妈妈看到约瑟的外套变小不合身，建议他扔掉旧外套。
[P9] 约瑟对爷爷说‘爷爷一定有办法’，爷爷拿起约瑟的旧外套，仔细翻看思考如何改造。
[P10] 爷爷正在专注地用剪刀裁剪和用针线缝制旧衣物，思考如何将旧料子改造成新物品，约瑟在旁边看着，周围是乡间木屋和一群白鹅。
[P11] 约瑟穿着爷爷改造成的奇妙背心去上学，但随着他长大，背心也逐渐变得老旧。
[P12] 妈妈看到约瑟的背心沾满胶水和颜料，觉得该扔掉了，约瑟可能又会去找爷爷想办法。
[P13] 约瑟的背心变得老旧，他再次对爷爷说‘爷爷一定有办法’，爷爷拿起背心仔细翻看，思考如何改造。
[P14] 爷爷正在专注地用剪刀裁剪和针线缝制旧衣物，思考如何改造，约瑟在一旁看着，背景是乡间木屋和村民。
[P15] 约瑟戴着爷爷改造成的奇妙领带每周去爷爷奶奶家，但随着他长大，领带也逐渐老旧。
[P16] 妈妈看到约瑟的领带沾了汤、脏了且变形，建议他扔掉。画面中妈妈在河边洗衣服，约瑟在水边玩耍，背景是乡间木屋和村民。
[P17] 约瑟的领带变旧后，他再次对爷爷说‘爷爷一定有办法’，爷爷拿起领带仔细翻看，思考如何改造。
[P18] 爷爷拿起剪刀和针线，开始裁剪和缝制旧衣物，约瑟在一旁看着，爷爷思考着如何将旧料子改造成新物品。
[P19] 约瑟用爷爷改造成的奇妙手帕包裹他收集的小石头，但随着他长大，手帕也变得老旧了。
[P20] 妈妈看到约瑟的手帕破旧不堪，建议他扔掉，约瑟则可能再次去找爷爷想办法。
[P21] 约瑟的手帕变旧后，他再次对爷爷说‘爷爷一定有办法’，爷爷拿起手帕仔细翻看，思考如何改造。
[P22] 爷爷正在用剪刀和针线改造旧布料，专注地裁剪和缝制，思考着还能做什么新东西。
[P23] 爷爷将旧布料改造成一颗奇妙的纽扣，约瑟把它装在吊带上，防止裤子滑落，两人在镜子前开心地查看效果。
[P24] 妈妈在井边问约瑟纽扣在哪里，约瑟发现纽扣不见了，画面中两个孩子在井边玩耍，水花四溅。
[P25] 约瑟找不到丢失的纽扣，于是跑去找爷爷帮忙。
[P26] 约瑟发现他珍贵的纽扣不见了，焦急地喊叫，妈妈随后赶来安慰他。
[P27] 约瑟焦急地告诉家人纽扣不见了，爷爷难过地摇头，承认自己也无法变出丢失的纽扣，并认同妈妈的说法。
[P28] 第二天，约瑟去上学，他拿起笔在纸上写着，思考着剩下的材料还能做什么。
[P29] 约瑟和家人围在一起，他背对观众展示一张写有文字的纸，家人鼓掌称赞，画面下方文字提示将剩余材料写成一个奇妙的故事。
